title: Import PDFs
acceptance: A PDF shared to the app is saved and readable
Its text is extracted so search finds it
Highlighting works, or the limitation is stated plainly rather than failing silently
The original file is retained the way original HTML is for web articles
notes: Named by the owner as the largest hole in capture: papers and documents currently cannot get in at all. High risk because it touches the data model and the reader's rendering assumptions — Post currently assumes extracted HTML blocks. PDFKit is on the import allowlist. Held as draft-equivalent until the reading-quality work lands, since it is the biggest build now that Listen is cut.

history.detail: reading-quality work it was held behind has landed (full screen, margins, images, Dynamic Type, contrast); touches narrowed off Cairn/Views/** so it can actually be scheduled
PDF rendering goes in its own PDFReaderView rather than ArticleBlockView, so it does not collide with the scroll-indicator work
